From Mad Professor: THE SUPER BLACK mini  gives you the classic 60's Black Panel sound in a compact package. SB mini's all analog circuit replicates the whole signal path of the amp. With the mini's added headroom you can get the sparkly and punchy clean tone that the Black Panel amps are known for. With the SB mini you can get the glorious amp break up tone with no excessive amount of volume needed - all the dynamics of a cranked up amp included. Use the SB mini as a tone shaper in front of your amp or plug it into the FX loop return or a cabinet IR and use it as a preamp. Controls PRESENCE  - Adjust the amount of high frequencies at pedal's output stage. VOLUME  - Sets the output level. GAIN  - Adjusts the amount of distortion. BASS  - Adjusts the amount of low frequencies. MIDDLE & TREBLE  - Adjusts the amount of middle and high frequencies in the preamp section. CUT  - Full bass level on the left and slightly cut low bass on the right. COMP  - Less compression with maximum dynamics on the left and more compression on the right. Technical Specifications Current draw  at 9VDC approx. 27 mA Input impedance  400K Ω Output impedance  1.5K Ω Voltage supply range  8-18V True bypass Power Requirements 9V battery or DC eliminator 2.1 mm plug center negative and positive sleeve. Super Black mini is protected against wrong DC eliminator polarity. Use recommended voltage for best results. Don't be a stranger!
